Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 34

“Attraction and aversion are seated in the senses toward their objects. One should not fall under the sway of these two, for they are one's adversaries.”

The workable point of intervention. Krishna does not ask Arjuna to stop having preferences, only to refuse them command — the enemy is the sway, not the sensation.
